meta.title: Assisteo Agny
meta.description: Snap a photo, the AI explains what you're looking at.

scan.headline: What are we

modeHints.auto: The AI figures out what's in the photo on its own.
modeHints.food: Estimated nutrition, storage tips and recipe ideas.
modeHints.document: Key points, important dates and things to do.
modeHints.vehicle: Prices, specs, maintenance and what to watch for.
modeHints.object: An object or a plant: identification, care, use and value.

scan.demoBody: No AI key is configured on the server, so the AI doesn’t look at your photos. Add GEMINI_API_KEY (free) or ANTHROPIC_API_KEY to .env.local and restart the server.
scan.webIntro: Drop a photo of a meal, a document or an object: the AI explains what it is and what you can do with it.
scan.dropHint: or paste it with Ctrl+V · JPG, PNG, WebP
scan.how1: Pick the kind of subject, or let the AI guess.
scan.how2: Drop, paste or snap your image.
scan.how3: Get facts, tips and reminders, saved to your history.
scan.pickHint: First choose what you’re photographing, then retake the photo.
scan.slow: The AI is in high demand right now: a few more seconds…

auto: A well-lit photo gets better answers: avoid shooting against the light.
Fill the frame with the subject, with little background.
After the analysis, ask your questions in the Question tab.
food: Photograph the whole plate, from above.
A fork or a hand next to it helps the AI estimate the portion.
Every food analysis comes with a recipe.
document: Lay the document flat, well lit, without glare.
Frame the whole page: due dates are often at the bottom.
For insurance, a reminder is set 5 days before it expires.
vehicle: From the front three-quarters, the grille and lights help recognise the model.
The badge and headlight shape are the best clues.
From the result, you can set a maintenance reminder.
object: Show the whole object, on a plain background.
A visible label or brand makes the answer more precise.
For a plant, photograph the leaves up close.

framing.object: All of it, on a plain background.

settings.title: Settings

settings.androidAppHintNoVersion: To install on an Android phone

sidebar.installBody: Add Assisteo Agny to your computer and open it like an app.
sidebar.mobileApps: Also available on Android and iOS.

onboarding.welcomeBody: Before we start, Assisteo Agny will ask for access to a few phone features. For each one we explain what it’s for: you can accept, decline, and change your mind any time.
onboarding.cameraBody: It’s the heart of the app: to analyse something, you need to take a photo of it or pick an image.
cameraReasons: Snap a meal, a document or an object
Pick a photo you already took from your gallery
onboarding.cameraPrivacy: Photos are only used for the analysis and never kept on our servers.
onboarding.notificationsBody: So we can let you know at the right time, without keeping the app open.
notificationsReasons: Know when an analysis is ready
Get your reminders: food to finish, a bill to pay, a plant to water
onboarding.denied: Access denied. You can turn it on later in your phone settings, under Apps.
onboarding.doneBody: You can change these permissions any time in Settings.

trial.overBody: You have used your {limit} free analyses. Choose a plan to continue: from Lite on, you get scans every month.

twoFactor.subtitle: On top of the token, a 6-digit code that changes every 30 seconds on your phone (Google Authenticator, Microsoft Authenticator, iPhone Passwords…).

twoFactor.badCode: Wrong or used code, or the QR code expired (15 min): try again.
